title: US equity markets closed — Washington's Birthday (opens a 4-session week carrying two expirations)
source: NEWS: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes; the page needs curl -L and its holiday data is JSON-ish '"text":"..."' cells rather than HTML table markup) and parsed cell-by-cell by this session. Against the year headers 2026 / 2027 / 2028, the "Washington's Birthday" row parses exactly as ['Monday, February 16', 'Monday, February 15', 'Monday, February 21'] — i.e. the NYSE is closed Monday 2027-02-15. Independently reproduced by rule: the federal holiday is the third Monday of February, and February 2027 begins on a Monday, so its Mondays are the 1st, 8th, 15th and 22nd and the third is 2027-02-15; the same rule returns 2026-02-16 and 2028-02-21, matching the page on both. Filed estimate on two counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a securities exchange's own holiday calendar (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:), and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence
notes: DISCOVERED during the vix-expiration-2027-02-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), the second market-CLOSURE entry on this calendar after good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26. Why a shut day earns a row here: it opens a FOUR-session week that carries two auctions of consequence — Tue 02-16, Wed 02-17 (the February VIX/VXM SOQ settlement, vix-expiration-2027-02-17, confirmed), Thu 02-18, Fri 02-19 (the February monthly equity expiration opex-2027-02-19 plus japan-cpi-2027-02-19, both estimate). A closure moves nothing by itself and no house playbook is calendar-keyed; what it changes is how few sessions those flows have to clear in. Second, mechanical consequence, computed this session against the same NYSE table: 2027-02-15 falls INSIDE the 30-day SOQ strip of the January VIX contract VX/F7 (2027-01-21 -> 2027-02-19), putting that strip at 21 trading sessions against a clean 22 — while falling three days OUTSIDE the February contract VX/G7's strip (2027-02-18 -> 2027-03-19), which is holiday-clean at 22. That contrast is what makes G7 the control in the paired richness test the vix-expiration-2027-02-17 ledger registers as FT-vix-expiration-2027-02-17-1; this entry is the falsifier's data source. Impact LOW and structural only. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no slot for an exchange-schedule event, so this is filed 'sector' — the same least-wrong choice good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 made and recorded, and the same open question about whether the union needs a 'market-structure' member. Not this lane's call to make. NOT proposed alongside it: the remaining 2027 NYSE closures (MLK 01-18, Memorial Day 05-31, Juneteenth observed 06-18, Independence Day observed 07-05, Labor Day 09-06, Thanksgiving 11-25, Christmas observed 12-24) — all read off the same fetch, none in any tracked event's corridor, and filing the NYSE year wholesale would manufacture research burden no session has been asked for. AMENDED 2026-09-05 by this event's initial research (docs/research/events/washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15.md): (1) DUPLICATE — presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 is THIS SAME NYSE holiday, filed 69 seconds later by the opex-2027-02-19 sweep (PR #1587 merged 17:10:18Z, #1591 merged 17:11:27Z). Same date, kind, impact, status, symbols and source row; they differ only in id, title wording and notes. Nothing detects it: scripts/event-scan-validation.mjs checks only for a duplicate id, which one-file-per-event filenames already make impossible. Proposed resolution, NOT executed here because a lane may write only its own file: first-merged-wins keeps this id and NYSE's own row name ('Washington's Birthday', per 5 U.S.C. 6103) agrees — but the sibling entry's opex-week notes are richer and must be MERGED into the survivor, not discarded. Registered as FT-washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15-1, score by 2026-10-05. (2) CROSS-ASSET FLANKS ARE CLEAN — SIFMA's 2027 US schedule, parsed from the page's embedded payload (its rendered 2027 tab is empty, which is why the sibling entry could only cite a 2026 pattern), gives Presidents Day 2027-02-15 a full fixed-income close with an EMPTY recommendation string, against six 2027 holidays that each carry a 2:00 p.m. ET flank (Good Friday Thu 03-25, Memorial Day Fri 05-28, July 4th Fri 07-02, Thanksgiving Fri 11-26, Christmas Thu 12-23, New Year's Fri 12-31). So Fri 2027-02-12 and Tue 2027-02-16 are full sessions in BOTH asset classes — the inverse of the good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 corridor, and no execution guard is owed. Registered as FT-washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15-2, score by 2027-02-12. (3) The VX/F7 21-vs-VX/G7 22 strip contrast above was re-verified this session against Cboe's own settlement CSV (VX/F7 settles 2027-01-20, VX/G7 2027-02-17) rather than left as an assertion.
